name: coder
description: Coder keeps a project's .coder/ design, diagnosis, plan, module, member, and issue documents honest: list reports illegal, missing, and malformed documents, checks diagnosis-code scopes, plan codes, module indexes, member rosters, and issue indexes, and verifies the lock hash; lock/unlock manage the lock; update replaces any .coder document through the review flow; create_issue creates numbered issues; render turns the documents into a design.html page with Mermaid diagrams.
